t.2.15.1: Having mounted his chariot, the glorious Rāma, his friends and kinsmen filled with delight, beheld the city thronged with people of many kinds.
t.2.15.2: Rāma went along the middle of the royal road, which was adorned with white houses resembling clouds and perfumed with the incense of agaru.
t.2.15.3: That splendid royal highway, shining and uncrowded, was lined with all kinds of wares and with foods of every sort, both high and low.
t.2.15.4: Hearing the many blessings uttered by his well-wishers, and honouring all the people as each deserved, he went on.
t.2.15.5: Having been consecrated today, take up that path which was followed by your grandfathers and likewise by your great-grandfathers, and keep to it faithfully.
t.2.15.6: Just as we were cherished by his father, and as by the forefathers of old, even more happily than that would we all dwell with Rāma as our king.
t.2.15.7: Enough of eating for today, and enough for us of even the highest treasures, if only we may see Rāma setting forth, established in the kingship.
t.2.15.8: For nothing else will ever be dearer than this: the consecration of Rāma, of boundless splendor, with the kingship.
t.2.15.9: Listening, unmoved, to these and other auspicious words of his well-wishers, words that honored him, Rāma went along the great highway.
t.2.15.10: For no man could draw away his mind or his eyes from that best of men, even after Rāghava had passed by.
t.2.15.11: For that righteous-souled one shows compassion to all the four varṇas and to their elders; therefore they are devoted to him.
t.2.15.12: Having reached the royal palace, which resembled the abode of great Indra, the prince, blazing with splendour, entered his father's dwelling.
t.2.15.14: Then, when the king's son had gone in to his father, all those people, filled with joy, waited for him to come out again, just as the lord of rivers, the ocean, awaits the rising of the moon.
t.2.15.13: Having passed through all the courtyards, the son of Daśaratha sent back all the people and entered the secluded inner apartments.
